history.summary: Local Shakti shrine associated with Goddess Gadiya on Gadiya Mountain (also called Kila Dongri), the highest hill near Kanker town. Traveler accounts (Tripadvisor) describe a Durga temple on the hilltop along with a very old Shiva cave temple, Sonai Rupai lake, and caves, reached by a steep climb of many steps; the Doodh river flows below the mountain and a festival is held on the mountain on Mahashivratri. Identity partially provisional: no authoritative record found under the exact name 'Maa Gadiya Temple', and sources do not clearly distinguish it from the Kankeshwari/Yogamaya shrine complex on the same hill — treat as a local hilltop Shakti shrine, not a documented historic monument. CSV 'state' column wrongly holds the town name 'Kanker' — corrected here to Chhattisgarh.

name: Maa Gadiya Temple
town_description: Kanker (Uttar Bastar Kanker) is the district headquarters town of Kanker district in southern Chhattisgarh, set on the Doodh river. Its landmark is Gadiya Mountain (Kila Dongri), once a fort capital with caves, lakes, and hilltop shrines, and the town's oldest temple tradition includes the Shivani Maa temple and the Kankeshwari (Yogmaya) shrine.
